Question: Joyce made \(12\) of her first \(30\) shots in the first three games of the basketball season, so her seasonal shooting average was \(40\%.\) In her next game, she took \(10\) shots and raised her seasonal shooting average to \(50\%.\) How many of these \(10\) shots did she make?
